row.name: Malkite Pelage
row.description: An exceptionally rare, odorless, and colorless poison utilized by the infamous Malkite Poisoners. Used almost exclusively for high-profile hits; a single drop coated on a blade or ingested is rapidly fatal. Exposure: Triggered via touch, consumption, or injection. Target must make an HT-7 (or Poison Resistance-7) roll. Failure: Deals 6d toxic damage, Cyclic (1 cycle per second). The target must make a new HT-7 roll each second. The damage continues until the victim is dead or treated with an Antidote Kit.
